chapter: Count Basie, Artie Shaw and the soprano experiments
title: Artie Shaw's 1949 saxophone section
summary: They name the saxophone section of Shaw's band, with Herbie Steward, Al Cohn, Socolow, Zoot Sims and Danny Bank.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, I’ve heard recordings of several…
I keep forgetting about things I’ve done.
Yeah, well there’s that CD that came out about five years ago of that band that had been kept in the can for 40 years.
Yeah. We had Al Cohn, wonderful band.
Danny Bank said it was the best saxophone section he ever played in.
Yeah, Herbie Steward, Al Cohn, Frankie Socolow, who was playing alto by then I think.
He was a second alto player.
And I’m trying to think who the second tenor player is.
Zoot, yeah that’s right! That is the best saxophone section probably that Danny Bank ever played in. Herbie was playing lead alto, he turned out to be a wonderful alto player.
